# Module 3 — classes and encapsulation

Allowed: module 1 tools, plus classes, objects, fields, constructors, methods, `private`, `public`, getters, setters, `this`, and `static` where `main` needs it.

Do not suggest or require: `if`, `else`, `switch`, loops, arrays, `enum`, inheritance, interfaces, abstract classes, nested classes, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, `throw`, lambda expressions, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Review encapsulation and whether the class matches the task. Do not ask for validation or branching.
